categories.main_business_segments: Gansu Golden Solar Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and photovoltaic modules. The company also produces fireproof glass and door/window systems, with a focus on photovoltaic cells and modules as its core business segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in N-type monocrystalline heterojunction solar cell technology (HJT), which offers higher conversion efficiency (up to 25.2%) and clear cost reduction pathways. Production involves advanced processes such as thin silicon wafers, silver paste optimization, layered TCO technology, precision welding, and the use of low-cost metal pastes. The manufacturing includes integrated production lines for solar cells and modules, with ongoing R&D to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic centralized and distributed power station operators, including state-owned enterprises in Northwest China, and international clients primarily in Singapore, India, and Southeast Asia. The company serves photovoltaic module manufacturers and power generation enterprises downstream in the solar energy value chain.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Gansu (Jiuquan) and Suzhou (Wujiang), and has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Macau, the UK, and other regions. Its sales markets cover domestic China and overseas markets including Singapore, Germany, and other parts of Asia and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gansu Golden Solar operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic industry chain, focusing on processing upstream silicon wafers into solar cells and assembling these into photovoltaic modules for downstream power generation customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in high-efficiency heterojunction solar cells, focusing on cost reduction and efficiency improvements through R&D projects such as new CVD cleaning processes, busbar-less module development, copper plating, and calcium titanate cell research. It aims to scale up production capacity, enhance product quality, and expand market share while investing in talent and management improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of photovoltaic solar cells and modules, with a direct sales model supplemented by distributors. The company also earns income from fireproof glass products and related construction services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods to customers, mainly at delivery or customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few capable of large-scale production of heterojunction solar cells in China, holding a leading position in this next-generation N-type photovoltaic technology segment. It competes with other domestic and international photovoltaic cell manufacturers focusing on high-efficiency technologies like PERC and HJT.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 580 million, an 11.2% increase year-over-year, but incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 361.76 million, reflecting industry-wide price declines and production ramp-up costs. Total assets reached nearly RMB 2.91 billion, with ongoing investments expanding production capacity, including a 4.8GW heterojunction project under construction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gansu Golden Solar emphasizes its advanced heterojunction solar cell technology that offers higher conversion efficiency, lower degradation, and simpler manufacturing processes compared to traditional P-type cells. Its products provide about 10% more power generation and approximately 3% lower levelized cost of electricity (LCOE), delivering superior economic benefits to customers. The company leverages its early mover advantage, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated production to maintain competitive cost and quality leadership.
